dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Preskúmajte poradie stehov, farby nití, preskoky, odstrihy a príkazy stroja pred výrobou. Náhľad dizajnu steh po stehu, prepínanie štýlov vykresľovania a export toho, čo vidíte.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Interaktívna simulácia výšivky, kontrola a export.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Pridržte pravítko pri obrazovke a ťahajte posúvač, kým lišta nižšie nebude presne 100 mm dlhá, potom stlačte OK.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Skopírujte obrázok v plnom rozlíšení do schránky

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Jazyk bol nastavený na {language}. Reštartovať InkSim teraz, aby sa to uplatnilo?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Použije sa systémový predvolený jazyk. Reštartovať InkSim teraz, aby sa to uplatnilo?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Všetky otvorené okná InkSim sa zatvoria a aktuálny súbor sa znova otvorí.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.
dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.translation: Podrobnosti o chybe nájdete v súbore output.err.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: Časový limit exportu CSV z Ink/Stitch vypršal.

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Otvoriť tento súbor SVG v novom okne Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: V tomto priečinku nie sú žiadne podporované súbory.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Dvojitým kliknutím na priečinok zobrazíte jeho súbory.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Dvojitým kliknutím na priečinok zobrazíte jeho súbory.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Na úpravu súborov SVG je potrebný Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured active Ink/Stitch installation is required for SVG preview.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Na náhľad SVG je potrebná nakonfigurovaná aktívna inštalácia Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG using the active Ink/Stitch installation.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Vytvoriť údaje stehov z tohto SVG pomocou aktívnej inštalácie Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Nedá sa spustiť aktívny skript Ink/Stitch ani jeho nakonfigurovaný spúšťač Pythonu.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Rozšírenie Ink/Stitch: kontrola zlyhala. Skúste to znova cez Nástroje...

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Rozšírenie Ink/Stitch: v priečinkoch rozšírení Inkscape sa nenašlo.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Rozšírenie Ink/Stitch: kontrola nie je možná, kým nenakonfigurujete Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Rozšírenie Ink/Stitch: zatiaľ neskontrolované. Skontrolujte ho cez Nástroje...

dialog.open_browser.status.svg_needs_ink.source: SVG preview runs directly through Ink/Stitch; editing requires Inkscape.
dialog.open_browser.status.svg_needs_ink.translation: Náhľad SVG sa vytvára priamo cez Ink/Stitch; na úpravy je potrebný Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.svg_ready.source: SVG preview runs directly through Ink/Stitch; Inkscape is used only for editing.
dialog.open_browser.status.svg_ready.translation: Náhľad SVG sa vytvára priamo cez Ink/Stitch; Inkscape slúži iba na úpravy.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Zdroj SVG. Na náhľad stehov je potrebný Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Zdroj SVG. Výberom možnosti Náhľad vytvoríte údaje stehov pomocou Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: Toto SVG je príliš veľké na zobrazenie náhľadu.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Nepodarilo sa vytvoriť dočasný súbor náhľadu: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Tento typ súboru sa v InkSim nedá otvoriť.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Nepodarilo sa uložiť stav rozšírenia Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.
integration.inkscape.inksim_none.translation: Nenašli sa žiadne priečinky s rozšírením InkSim.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Nepodarilo sa skontrolovať priečinky rozšírení Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Nepodarilo sa nainštalovať rozšírenia InkSim pre Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Rozšírenia InkSim pre Inkscape boli nainštalované alebo aktualizované v priečinku {path}. Načítajte ich reštartovaním Inkscape.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Inkscape sa v systémovej ceste nenašiel.

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Nepodarilo sa načítať priečinky rozšírení Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Reštartujte Inkscape, aby sa použil nový interpret Pythonu.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Nepodarilo sa odstrániť starý priečinok rozšírenia InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Staré priečinky rozšírení InkSim boli odstránené. Zoznam rozšírení obnovíte reštartovaním Inkscape.

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Zistené nastavenie bolo uložené do konfigurácie InkSim.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Požadovaný spúšťač „{command}“ sa nenašiel; predvoľba sa nezmenila.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape sa nenašiel. Výberom jeho spustiteľného súboru skontrolujete nastavenie.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Nepodarilo sa skontrolovať ani aktualizovať interpret Pythonu: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Predvoľba interpreta Pythonu sa neskontrolovala, pretože priečinok rozšírení používateľa nie je dostupný.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Reštartujte Inkscape, aby sa použil aktualizovaný interpret.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Vyberte spustiteľný súbor Inkscape na kontrolu nastavenia.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape neodpovedal do {seconds} sekúnd. Komunikáciu môže blokovať iná inštancia Inkscape alebo rozšírenie. Zatvorte ostatné inštancie Inkscape alebo vypnite blokujúce rozšírenie a skúste to znova.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Požadovaný spúšťač „{command}“ sa nenašiel. Nainštalujte si nástroj uvr sami pomocou príkazu `uv tool install uvr` a potom znova spustite túto konfiguráciu. InkSim ho nenainštaluje.

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Nie je načítaný žiadny súbor výšivky na export.

message.no_file_to_save.translation: Nie je načítaný žiadny súbor výšivky.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Resetovať šírku čiary a faktory tieňovania

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Kliknite pre nastavenie tmavého faktora, svetlého faktora a šírky čiary

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Pohľad zospodu (kresliť neskoršie stehy pod skoršie)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Cyklovať zobrazenie preskokov: vypnuté, všetky, iba rizikové
